text: In consultation with the Chair, the following additional meetings of the Aboriginal Affairs Committee have been scheduled in 2018: - Friday, April 20, 2018; and - Monday, June 25, 2018. All meetings will be held in Committee Room 2 at Toronto City Hall, 100 Queen Street West, Toronto, and begin at 9:30 a.m. As communicated to you on February 2, 2018, the meeting scheduled for May 30, 2018 has been cancelled. The Aboriginal Affairs Committee meeting schedule is available on the City's website at: www.toronto.ca/council.
The Aboriginal Affairs Committee received the item for information.
